definitions.explanation: The third day of any month.

examples.japanese: {三日|みっか}⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
1⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{三日|みっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧。
{三日|みっか}⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It will arrive in three days.

examples.japanese: {三日|みっか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{三日|みっか}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: It rained for three days straight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{三日|みっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a reservation for the 3rd of next month.

examples.japanese: {三日|みっか}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{三日|みっか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
{三日|みっか}⟦{坊主|ぼうず}→坊主：10119_bouzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: It ended after just three days (gave up quickly).

notes:
{三日|みっか} has two meanings: a duration of three days, and the 3rd day of the month. Context usually makes the meaning clear.

DAYS OF THE MONTH (1-10):
- ⟦{一日|ついたち}→一日：10993_tsuitachi⟧, ⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧, {三日|みっか}, ⟦{四日|よっか}→四日：02985_yokka⟧, ⟦{五日|いつか}→五日：28460_itsuka⟧
- ⟦{六日|むいか}→六日：02973_muika⟧, ⟦{七日|なのか}→七日：02927_nanoka⟧, ⟦{八日|ようか}→八日：02983_youka⟧, ⟦{九日|ここのか}→九日：02901_kokonoka⟧, ⟦{十日|とおか}→十日：02917_tooka⟧

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {三日|みっか}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧: three days (with counter)
- {三日|みっか}⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧: three days later
- {三日|みっか}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: three days ago
{三日|みっか}⟦{坊主|ぼうず}→坊主：10119_bouzu⟧ literally "three-day monk" means someone who gives up easily or lacks perseverance. Used when someone starts something but quickly abandons it.
